## Activity

During April 2022, Central Eye Clinic completed 162 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as planned, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded capture total provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. No additional operational issue is identified in the available information.

## Image quality

Of the 162 captures completed at Central Eye Clinic, 7 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.3. The result indicates that most captures were available for grading, while a smaller proportion could not be assessed. The ungradable captures remain included in the activity total and are reported separately from the grading outcome.

## Grading

The grading record shows 40 referable results. The median lag for grading was 20. This measure records the midpoint of the reported grading wait and should be considered alongside the referable result count and image quality information. Overall, the report records completed activity, the number and rate of ungradable captures, referable results, and the median grading lag for Central Eye Clinic in April 2022.
